reviews.text: This company is a scam. I was scheduled for June 1st, they did not show up til Jun 4th after several phone calls and messages. Then after that every day they would say they will show up and they are busy but still will show up. I was concerned that the pool had started to get green and told them. They came and brushed the wall and said that they don't put chemicals because they don't carry shock every where with them as it is toxic material!!! I don't know of any other pool company that says something like that. They said they will be back day after to add chemicals and they will address the issue. Now he texted me that the pool is green and they would not address that unless I pay. I would've gone to others, but waited for them as they would say they will come. The rudeness and bad businesses is through the roof.pictures are first day and after 7 day that they kept pushing the date.

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of hiring RMD Pool Service for our residential pool cleaning and maintenance, and I couldn't be happier with the quality and professionalism they offer.

From the moment I made the first call, it was apparent that customer service is a top priority for this local business. They were prompt in responding to my inquiries, offering a wide range of services like pool cleaning, chemical balancing, and even equipment repair — a true one-stop-shop for all your pool care needs.

What sets RMD Pool Service apart is their attention to detail. They don't just skim and vacuum; they also check the chemical balance, ensure the filters are clean, and even give advice on how to maintain the pool in between their service visits. Plus, they use top-of-the-line equipment and eco-friendly cleaning solutions, which is a significant factor for any environmentally conscious homeowner like myself.

The team was punctual, arriving right on time for the scheduled appointment. They were also extremely courteous and ensured all my questions were answered. It's rare to find a company that excels in both technical expertise and customer relations, but RMD Pool Service does just that.

Their pricing is transparent and reasonable, providing exceptional value for the high-quality service received. I've had experience with other pool service companies in the past, but none have met the high standards set by RMD Pool Service.

In summary, if you're in need of any pool services, I highly recommend RMD Pool Service. Their professional team, cutting-edge equipment, and stellar customer service make them the go-to choice for any pool owner.

I look forward to many more years of hassle-free pool enjoyment, thanks to RMD Pool Service!

reviews.text:
I can't say enough good things about RMD Pool Service. Seriously, if you own a pool and want to make your life easier, give them a call. Right from the first phone conversation, it was obvious that they actually care about their customers.

What really stands out? For one, they offer pretty much everything you need to keep your pool looking great—cleaning, chemical balancing, and even fixing up equipment. It's like having a pool concierge; they handle it all.

But it's their attention to detail that makes me a fan for life. They don't just do a quick clean and go. They check the chemical levels, make sure the filters are good, and even give me tips for keeping things running smoothly between their visits. Plus, they're using some eco-friendly products, which is a big win in my book.

Timing-wise, they're spot on. They show up when they say they will, and they're super respectful and professional. It's hard to find a company these days that nails both the technical stuff and customer service, but these guys do.

Price-wise, it's all upfront and reasonable, especially for the quality you're getting. I've tried other pool services before, but none have lived up to the standard set by RMD Pool Service.

So, if you're in the market for pool services, look no further. RMD Pool Service is the real deal: solid team, top-notch equipment, and a customer service experience that's genuinely pleasant. Thanks to them, I'm looking forward to enjoying my pool for many summers to come. Easily a 5-star experience.

data.summary: The negative reviews are highly credible and describe serious, repeated failures in service delivery and professionalism. The single positive review lacks specific detail and feels inauthentic. The low total review count (14) for a pool service in a major metro area is a concern. The evidence strongly suggests operational problems and potentially deceptive practices, outweighing the generic positive feedback.
fake_signals: The single 5-star review is overly generic, promotional, and reads like marketing copy, contrasting sharply with the detailed negative experiences.
The business appears in many Yelp search result lists but has no actual Yelp reviews or rating, suggesting low customer engagement or possible suppression.
authentic_signals: Negative reviews contain highly specific details: dates (June 1st, Jun 4th), sequences of events, and direct quotes from the service provider.
Negative reviews describe consistent patterns of unprofessional behavior (ghosting, false promises, refusal to perform standard service).
Writing styles in negative reviews are varied and emotionally authentic, expressing clear frustration.
complaint_patterns: Failure to show up for scheduled service
Misleading communication (spam texts, refusal of new customers)
Refusal to perform basic chemical treatment
Demanding additional payment for problems they created
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google rating of 4.4 is based on only 14 reviews, but the content of the negative reviews is severe and specific, describing unprofessional and potentially fraudulent behavior. The positive review is generic and reads like promotional copy, creating a stark contrast in authenticity. The BBB 'A' rating lacks complaint data to verify.
